question: Which existing English source-provision findings support a defensible empirical paper after comparison with close prior work, and do objectively empty or repeated outputs qualify the observed deployment differences?
decision: Prioritize the empirical route: integrate original ordinal evidence, matched deployment costs, narrowly defined raw-output diagnostics and verified prior art into a coherent manuscript. No novel algorithm is justified before a semantically meaningful failure and technical distinction are established.
alternatives: New algorithm or steering prototype: broad mechanisms already overlap published steering/retrieval/alignment work, the new200semantic ratings are absent, and52nonreserve generations cannot by themselves establish fair baselines, ablations and independent fidelity validation. Do not implement a named invention without evidence.

New speaker/model collection: the independent English cohort is not source-qualified; do not relax failed gates or spend160reserved generations. Existing same-speaker outputs cannot become independent replication.

Existing-evidence empirical synthesis: directly addresses current RQ1 and deployment parts ofRQ3, preserves RQ2/RQ4 gaps, requires no new generation or human-label invention. Selected on validity and information gained, not expected positive results.

data.scope: All300existing English outputs: originalQwen3-0.6B100 plusQwen2.5-1.5BBase100 andInstruct100, same5development speakers and10contexts, all8factorial plus2style-control cells.

diagnostics.raw_empty: Indicator exact native response content equals the empty string; report all allocated and generated denominators separately. This is not missing execution.
diagnostics.whitespace_empty: Indicator native content.strip() equals the empty string; do not trim or overwrite the archived response. Non-English or punctuation-only strings are not silently reclassified as empty.
diagnostics.repeat5_excess: Use the unchanged English words() rule in english_sfh_analysis_v1.py. For consecutive five-word windows, (number of windows minus number of distinct windows)/number of windows. If fewer than5words, NA, not zero.
diagnostics.repeat5_any: Indicator at least one duplicate consecutive five-word window, only where at least one window exists. This is literal surface recurrence, not a validated semantic repetition or degeneration label.
diagnostics.prefix20_repeat5_excess: Same rate on exactly the first20 extracted words, only for responses with at least20words. A fixed-opportunity descriptive sensitivity, not output-length-adjusted causality; selection into this subset is post-treatment.
diagnostics.no_threshold_tuning: No success threshold, language quality score, semantic error label, inferred persona identity or example selection. Preserve all computed values including zeros, NA and negative contrasts.
diagnostics.interpretation: Literal recurrence can reflect useful terminology or quotation; more output provides more repetition opportunities. These diagnostics cannot establish Persona Fidelity, factual accuracy, temporal contamination, human preference or model superiority. Different model families/templates/EOS/quantizations and fixed blocks remain confounded.

analysis.reuse: Use the existing raw-journal audits and two frozen factorial arithmetic implementations. Add only this bounded diagnostic adapter and authored edge-case tests; do not edit frozen helpers or create another general evaluator.
analysis.coverage: For every model/condition/metric report allocated, applicable and unavailable counts. Complete-speaker contrasts target only speakers with all required cells; never silently treat short-output NA as zero or equal coverage.
analysis.contrasts: All7factorial contrasts and3style controls per configuration. Matched newInstruct-minus-Base contrasts where both cells are applicable. Original0.6B is a historical configuration reference, not a pure size contrast.
analysis.uncertainty: Equal-context then equal-speaker arithmetic; speaker profiles and leave-one-speaker-out influence, not confidence intervals or calibrated significance. No arbitrary participant independence assumption.
analysis.independent_check: Cross-check each literal diagnostic with a separate direct-count implementation and compare factorial summaries using the existing second implementation. Re-run the additive analysis read-only from raw evidence; do not call this independent experimental validation.

publication: Produce a new coherent English manuscript version, preserving the historical working manuscript and checkpoints. Explicitly distinguish source-provision design from original shared-sufficient-evidence TrackA; map condition bits and RQ numbering instead of silently rewriting original protocol. Known,partially novel,potentially novel and unsupported claims must be separated.
preservation: Raw dialogues, source IDs, per-response diagnostics and review records stay private. Public output aggregates/hashes only. No Git add,commit,push; no large replacement checkpoint. Stop new analysis on source/journal/hash mismatch and preserve any failed output without overwrite.
